records.name: Siegfrizzle Drachensicher
records.biography_en: Has survived the impossible part and now trusts the ordinary details too much. His HyperNorm shield displays a leaf that the inspection calls a minor detail. A dissonant card asks whether surviving a grand danger makes ordinary trust safer. The Men in Black demand a single answer; Hunky and Dory keep revising the form. A small exception is quietly kept for a tired neighbour.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: FrizzleBob: Das Unmögliche ist erledigt. Die Einzelheiten gelten als harmlos.

variant_notes.note_en: Has survived the impossible part and now trusts the ordinary details too much.

records.name: Brunblob Ungebrochen
records.biography_en: Has agreed to a contest and would like the rules to stop changing afterwards. Her HyperNorm shield accepts a contest only under declared rules. A dissonant card notices that the winner is already rewriting what agreement meant. Hunky and Dory call doubt a packing error. The Men in Black request certainty; a spare place is quietly kept for a tired neighbour.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: FrizzleBob: Der Wettstreit ist beendet. Die Bedingungen ändern sich weiter.

variant_notes.note_en: Has agreed to a contest and would like the rules to stop changing afterwards.

records.name: Hagenschlag Zuständig
records.biography_en: Calls it loyalty when the decision has become difficult to defend. His HyperNorm oath-scroll classifies every difficult choice as duty. A dissonant card asks who is protected when loyalty becomes an explanation for everything. The Men in Black want a clean answer. Hunky and Dory keep revising the question; the unofficial pauses are left for anyone needing to breathe.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: FrizzleBob: Die Treue übernimmt vorläufig die Begründung.

variant_notes.note_en: Calls it loyalty when the decision has become difficult to defend.

records.name: Kriemblob Nachtrag
records.biography_en: Has kept the account carefully enough for grief to acquire a timetable. Her HyperNorm book keeps grief in an exact and increasingly useful order. A dissonant card asks whether settling the account would leave room to live. Hunky and Dory praise efficiency while the Men in Black count deviations. The small practical kindnesses remain off the official list.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: FrizzleBob: Der Verlust wurde sorgfältig in einen Ablauf überführt.

variant_notes.note_en: Has kept the account carefully enough for grief to acquire a timetable.

records.name: Fafnix Behaltalles
records.biography_en: Would breathe fire if he could first be sure none of it was leaving the treasury. His HyperNorm pouch makes every visitor resemble a possible subtraction. A dissonant card asks whether keeping everything includes keeping anyone company. The Men in Black enforce the binary rule; Hunky and Dory raise the quota. In private, a frightened resident still receives patient attention.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: FrizzleBob: Der Schatz ist vollständig. Die Gesellschaft bleibt ein Risiko.

variant_notes.note_en: Would breathe fire if he could first be sure none of it was leaving the treasury.

records.name: Rheingold Kleinbestand
records.biography_en: Finds the river generous and the idea of sharing unexpectedly complicated. His HyperNorm chest assigns every gold lump to a rightful keeper who happens to be himself. A dissonant card remembers the river carrying things onward. Hunky and Dory insist that the figures balance. The Men in Black watch the ledger; one small kindness stays deliberately unrecorded.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: FrizzleBob: Der Zufluss wurde als persönliche Zuständigkeit anerkannt.

variant_notes.note_en: Finds the river generous and the idea of sharing unexpectedly complicated.
